subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A lot of olive oil is ___________ in Spain this year.
solution:
The correct answer is '**produced**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**produced**" is the correct form of the verb used in the passive voice to indicate that something (olive oil) is being created or made in Spain this year.
 
• Option 1: "**produce**" is incorrect as it is the base form and does not fit grammatically.
 
• Option 2: "**producing**" is incorrect as it is the present participle and does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• Option 3: "**production**" is a noun and does not fit grammatically in the blank.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *A lot of olive oil is produced__ in Spain this year.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Produce**: Base form of the verb, not suitable for passive voice structure here.
 
• **Producing**: Present participle, not suitable for the blank in this context.
 
• **Production**: Noun, does not fit the sentence grammatically.
